ValidationRule.description: This rule is fired when Rush is TRUE and Cut-Off Time is not equal to null .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , IME_SC_Rush__c = TRUE , NOT ( ISPICKVAL (IME_SC_Cut_Off_Time__c , "")), IME_SC_SLA_Missed__c != true )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: User selected Cut off Time is not acceptable for Rush.
